description: Road Surface and Surrounding Terrain Dataset: Images of Dalton Highway (82 mi Material Site), Alaska, 2024. is a data set deposited in UC Santa Barbara by its authors Emmanuel Chukwuemeka, Timothy Pasch (Research Institute for Autonomous System, University of North Dakota). This dataset comprises high-resolution aerial images captured using a Parrot Anafi remote-controlled aircraft along various sections of the Dalton Highway in Alaska during August 2024. The Dalton Highway, a critical transportation corridor in the Arctic, traverses regions prone to permafrost degradation and dynamic environmental changes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: XML. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
